notablePrerequisites:
Fear of Missing Out cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
Mysterious Limousine does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
One of Combat Celebrant or Fear of Missing Out must be on the battlefield, with the other exiled by Mysterious Limousine.
description:
Declare either Combat Celebrant or Fear of Missing Out and Mysterious Limousine as attackers.
Mysterious Limousine and either Combat Celebrant or Fear of Missing Out trigger.
Resolve the Combat Celebrant or Fear of Missing Out trigger, untapping Mysterious Limousine and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Mysterious Limousine trigger, exiling Combat Celebrant or Fear of Missing Out from the battlefield, and then returning Combat Celebrant or Fear of Missing Out from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.
